title: Links are flat hash ids, never paths
quote: Reference everything flat by hash ids, never by paths.
means: Every link in brain is a doc's flat hash id, never a path; folders are only where files sit. brain resolves an id to its file, and brain index writes the map the apps read.

supersedes.what: A link is the doc's flat hash id; its commit is computed (d-3956), not written into the link.

reflection.checked: every decision before d-eb50 that held
reflection.result: supersedes d-0e44 in part (how a link is written)
